from_quote: The general legislature is restrained from prohibiting the further importation of slaves for twenty odd years.
rationale: States that the general legislature is restrained for twenty odd years from prohibiting importation, the restriction in this clause.

from_quote: not to controversies between citizens of the same state (except where they claim under grants of different states)
rationale: Describes the extent of the federal judiciary, naming the exception for citizens of the same state claiming under grants of different states, a category listed in this clause.
to_quote: between Citizens of the same State claiming Lands under Grants of different States

from_quote: except the few in which it has original and not appellate jurisdiction
rationale: Names the few cases in which the supreme federal court has original and not appellate jurisdiction, the division made in this clause.

from_quote: the president and senate's power to make treaties
rationale: Names the power of the president and senate to make treaties, the power given in this clause.
to_quote: by and with the Advice and Consent of the Senate, to make Treaties
